name: share
description: share — publish an HTML artifact (plan, viz, report) to a shareable link via the standalone `artifacts share` CLI (`@phnx-labs/artifacts-cli`): the managed Phoenix endpoint when signed in (`artifacts auth login`), else your own Cloudflare R2 (`artifacts share setup`). `/share` posts a public link with an unfurling OG preview card; `/share --private` posts an unlisted, auto-expiring (`--no-cover --expire 7d`) link with no preview.
